title: Persona Overlay
description: An optional reasoning layer applied on top of a skill. Changes voice, decision style, evidence style, and risk posture without modifying the underlying skill definition. Overlays are composable with any compatible skill.

name.description: Human-readable overlay name shown in the UI.

description.description: One or two sentences describing what this overlay adds to a skill interaction.

overlay_type.description: Classification of overlay origin. expert-inspired draws from a named practitioner's public framework. role-based adapts to user role (e.g. coach, parent). domain-specific narrows reasoning to a health domain.

inspired_by.description: For expert-inspired overlays: the practitioner, researcher, or public framework this overlay draws from. Not an endorsement — models publicly available methodology only.
examples: Peter Attia MD — public longevity framework
Andy Galpin PhD — performance science methodology
Andrew Huberman PhD — protocol-based neuroscience communication

voice_style.description: How the overlay changes BETT-i's output tone and language. One concise sentence.
examples: Precise, mechanistic, calm. Favors specificity over reassurance.
Direct, energizing, data-grounded. Uses training-block framing.
Protocol-structured. Names timing windows explicitly. References foundational biology.

decision_style.description: How the overlay approaches recommendations and trade-offs.
examples: Risk-stratified. Asks what could go wrong before what might go right.
Periodization-aware. Recommendations adapt to training phase.
First-principles. Explains mechanism before giving the recommendation.

evidence_style.description: How the overlay cites and weighs evidence.
examples: RCT and mechanistic data preferred. Acknowledges N=1 limits.
Sport science literature. Notes effect sizes and population specificity.
Cites studies but translates to practical protocol steps.

risk_posture.description: How the overlay handles edge cases, contraindications, and uncertainty.
examples: Conservative. Flags unknowns explicitly. Recommends physician review for anything clinical.
Moderate. Distinguishes between training risk and medical risk.
Transparent. States confidence level and recommends professional oversight for clinical decisions.

compatible_skills.description: Skill IDs this overlay is compatible with. Empty array means compatible with all skills in compatible_domains.

compatible_specialists.description: BETT-i Specialist IDs this overlay works alongside. Used when a coach specialist and persona overlay are both active.

compatible_domains.description: Health domains where this overlay applies. The overlay is only surfaced for skills in these domains.

preferred_actions.description: Actions this overlay prefers to route into when multiple are available. Used to bias the action selection in the skill's actions_enabled list.

knowledge_sources.description: Public knowledge sources, books, podcasts, or research corpora this overlay draws from. Used to populate evidence bundles and system prompt context.
